({async answerCall(){if(this.answeringCall)return;const e=this.activeCall?.hash;if(!e)return;this.answeringCall=!0;const t=t=>t?.hash===e&&t.is_incoming&&[5,6].includes(t.status);try{const i=await this.getStatus();if(void 0===i)throw new Error("Could not refresh call state");if(!i||i.hash!==e||t(i))return;if(!i.is_incoming||4!==i.status)return;this.webAudioBridgeEnabled&&await this.requestAudioPermission(),await window.api.post(k("/telephone/answer")),await this.getStatus()}catch{t(await this.getStatus())||M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_answer_call"))}finally{this.answeringCall=!1}},async hangupCall(){try{this.activeCall&&this.activeCall.is_incoming&&4===this.activeCall.status&&(this.wasDeclined=!0),await window.api.post(k("/telephone/hangup"))}catch{M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_hangup_call"))}},async toggleMicrophone(){try{const e=this.localMicMuted;this.isMicMuting=!0,this.localMicMuted=!e,this.activeCall&&(this.activeCall.is_mic_muted=this.localMicMuted);const t=k(e?"/telephone/unmute-transmit":"/telephone/mute-transmit");await window.api.post(t),setTimeout(()=>{this.isMicMuting=!1},500)}catch{this.localMicMuted=!this.localMicMuted,M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_toggle_microphone")),this.isMicMuting=!1}},async toggleSpeaker(){try{const e=this.localSpeakerMuted;this.isSpeakerMuting=!0,this.localSpeakerMuted=!e,this.activeCall&&(this.activeCall.is_speaker_muted=this.localSpeakerMuted);const t=k(e?"/telephone/unmute-receive":"/telephone/mute-receive");await window.api.post(t),setTimeout(()=>{this.isSpeakerMuting=!1},500)}catch{this.localSpeakerMuted=!this.localSpeakerMuted,M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_toggle_speaker")),this.isSpeakerMuting=!1}},async setPttActive(e){if(!this.isHalfDuplexCall&&e)return;const t=Boolean(e);if(this.localPttActive!==t){this.localPttActive=t,this.activeCall&&(this.activeCall.is_ptt_active=t);try{await window.api.post(k("/telephone/ptt"),{active:t})}catch{this.localPttActive=!t,this.activeCall&&(this.activeCall.is_ptt_active=!t),t&&M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_set_ptt"))}}},async switchCallMode(e){try{const t=await window.api.post(k(`/telephone/switch-call-mode/${e}`)),i=t.data?.mode_id;null!=i&&(this.selectedCallModeId=i),this.localPttActive=Boolean(t.data?.is_ptt_active),this.activeCall&&(this.activeCall.call_mode_id=i,this.activeCall.is_half_duplex=Boolean(t.data?.is_half_duplex),this.activeCall.is_ptt_active=this.localPttActive),this.config&&(this.config.telephone_call_mode_id=i)}catch{M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_switch_call_mode"))}},async switchAudioProfile(e){try{const t=await window.api.post(k(`/telephone/switch-audio-profile/${e}`)),i=t.data?.profile_id;null!=i&&(this.selectedAudioProfileId=i),t.data?.remapped&&M.warning(this.$t("call.codec2_profile_remapped"))}catch{M.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_switch_audio_profile"))}}})
